record.one_liner: MongoDB Atlas is a cloud database service providing programmatic access via an Administration API, CLI, Go SDK, and various infrastructure-as-code integrations.
record.blocker: Authentication methods for the API are not specified in the provided text.

access_test.quote: This command creates a free cluster on MongoDB Atlas. atlas setup --clusterName myDeployment

api_type.quote: Use the REST API and available client SDKs to power search and retrieval in your AI applications.

api_breadth.quote: Atlas Administration API resources add, edit, or delete administrative objects within Atlas , including projects, users, and clusters.
